welcome.title: JapaLife
welcome.lead: Hustle in Lagos, sort your papers, japa, and build a life abroad.
welcome.disclaimerHeading: This is a game, not immigration advice
disclaimer: Fees, rules, waiting times and prices in JapaLife are simplified, can be out of date, and some are made up for gameplay. Never use them to plan a real move.
For real decisions, use official sources only: **gov.uk** for the UK and **canada.ca** for Canada. Nobody can genuinely guarantee you a visa, so treat any agent who promises one as a scam.
welcome.ageQuestion: JapaLife is for players aged 18 and over. Are you 18 or older?
welcome.underage: Sorry, JapaLife is only for players aged 18 and over.

hud.noFuel: No light · no fuel, sleeping badly
hud.lowMorale: Low morale · resting slower, earning less

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty: Nothing yet. News about your shifts, rent and family shows up here.

documents.title: Documents
documents.empty: You have no documents yet. Your first step is the NIN: ask around Yaba for the NIMC office.

map.hint: Tap anywhere to find the way there by road.
map.stuck: Something's in the way. Find your way round from here.

places.rentLateFee: Pay within {time} or the landlord adds a {fee} late fee
places.okadaNote: Commercial okada is banned on Lagos Mainland. The riders keep to the back streets, and the task force sometimes stops them.
places.fuelRuns: Runs your gen {hours}h when NEPA takes light at night
places.agentPitch: A man outside the gate says he can get it done in three days for {fee}, cash, to his personal account. No need to queue.

notices.rentLateFee: Your landlord added a {amount} late fee. Pay your rent at home to stop more fees.
notices.rentLateFeeBroke: Your landlord came for a {amount} late fee you couldn't pay, and the whole compound heard. Pay your rent at home.
notices.taskForce: The task force stopped your okada before {place}. You're walking the rest, and the fare is gone.
notices.documentReady: Your {name} is ready. Check your documents list for what to do next.
notices.documentExpiring: Your {name} runs out in about {days} days. Apply again before then, or your next step may stall.
notices.documentExpired: Your {name} has expired. You can apply for a new one at the same office.
notices.agentSilent: He doesn't pick your calls any more, and no {name} is coming. Real offices never ask you to pay into a personal account. Your money is gone, but you can still apply properly at the office.

rejections.rate_limited: Easy, one thing at a time.
rejections.starving: You're too hungry to work. Go and chop something first.
rejections.no_energy: You're too tired to work. Rest a bit first.
rejections.blackout: NEPA has taken light. No work until power comes back.
rejections.daily_limit: That's enough work for today. Come back tomorrow.
rejections.insufficient_funds: Your money isn't enough for that.
rejections.already_full: You're too full for that. Try something lighter, or wait small.
rejections.rent_not_due: Rent isn't due yet. Landlord can wait.
rejections.tank_full: Your jerrycan can't hold that much more.
rejections.choice_expired: Too late. They've stopped waiting for an answer.
rejections.already_applied: You already have that, or you're still waiting for it.
rejections.missing_document: You need another document before they'll take that one.
